observations: Photo 0: a yard of many blue plastic drums standing upright on bare earth, more stacked behind.

Photo 0: the front drums are open-top type with wide blue plastic lids, several lids propped open; they look roughly the full-size barrel class (about 200 to 250 litre), but no capacity marking is readable.
Photo 0: a few smaller blue and white containers are visible in the background.
Photo 0: drums look used: scuffed, dusty, some marks on the sides; no cracks are visible from this angle but the bases and insides are not shown.
Photo 0: a watermark across the lower middle reads something like 'SUNNY EBERE GENUINE', a seller's mark, not a product brand.
No photo of the insides, the bases, a capacity mark, or the steel drums the text mentions; quantity for sale is not stated.

identity.kind: blue plastic open top drum with lid (water storage drum, about 200 to 250 litre)

claims.claim: Container drums, water storage drums, plastic barrel
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows many blue plastic open-top drums with lids.
Only drums are clearly shown in photo 0; no kegs (jerrycans) are clearly visible.
No steel drum is visible in photo 0.
Previous contents of used drums cannot be known from a photo; no inside shot.

risks.risk: Drums previously held chemicals or oils and are not safe for drinking water.
risks.proof: Close photo inside a drum with the lid off, and any old label or marking on the drum wall.
risks.if_unproven: as industrial-use drums, not food or water grade

risks.risk: Cracks, holes or split bases that leak.
risks.proof: Photo of a drum tipped on its side showing the base, and a clip of it filled with water standing without leaking.
risks.if_unproven: as one drum in the lot leaking or damaged

risks.risk: Lids missing, cracked or not sealing; lid ring or clamp missing.
risks.proof: Close photo of a lid closed and locked on a drum.
risks.if_unproven: as drums without a working lid

risks.risk: Actual capacity smaller than full-size barrel.
risks.proof: Photo of the capacity marking on the drum, or a drum beside a tape measure showing height.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest common drum size

risks.risk: Quantity on offer unknown; price could be per drum or per lot.
risks.proof: Seller to state the number of drums and whether the price is per piece.

proof_requests: Close photo inside a drum with the lid off, showing what it last held.
Photo of the capacity marking or a drum against a tape measure.
Photo of the base of one drum and of a lid closed on it.
Number of drums offered and whether the price is per drum.
response.reason: Photo 0 clearly shows used blue plastic open-top drums with lids, a plain good identified by type; priced per single drum at its worst case as a used industrial drum of the smallest common size until capacity and previous contents are proven.
